title: Mild-Style Shrimp Boil with Corn and Red Potatoes
description: This mild-style shrimp boil with corn and red potatoes recipe is more savory than spicy. It's seasoned with coriander, dill, allspice, and mustard seeds.
ingredients: 8 cups water, or more as needed
9 small red potatoes, or more to taste
3 ears corn, shucked and cut into thirds, or more to taste
16 ounces raw shrimp, headless and shells on

steps.text: Combine 2 cups boiling water and bouillon cubes in a large pot; stir until dissolved. Add 8 cups water, onion, garlic, butter, bay leaves, salt, coriander seeds, dill seeds, mustard seeds, celery seeds, allspice berries, green peppercorns, and cloves; bring to a boil, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium; simmer for 20 minutes.
Squeeze lemon juice into the pot, then add lemon to the pot. Add potatoes; cook for 14 minutes. Add corn; cook 6 minutes more. Add shrimp; cook until opaque, about 3 minutes. Remove pot from heat.
Add ice cubes to the pot; let sit for 5 minutes.

Place several layers of newspaper on the dining table or on a baking sheet; transfer shrimp, potatoes, and corn onto center of the newspaper using a slotted spoon. Or transfer shrimp, potatoes, and corn to a serving dish to serve.
